aboutHtml:
Alastair and Louise Thomson own STIHL SHOP Upper Hutt. We're locals who believe in serving our community with good equipment and support you can trust. Beyond the shop, you'll find us backing local groups like Hutt High School Water Polo, HOBM Rugby, and the Upper Hutt Axemens Club.

We stock STIHL, Hansa, Masport, Rover, Cub Cadet, Honda Power Equipment, Walker, and Hustler. Whether you're after a chainsaw, mower, or anything in between, we have the brands people rely on. With our full service workshop, your equipment will be kept in great working condition for years to come.

Come in and have a yarn. We'll help you find what works for your place, and we're here when you need servicing or parts.
